faq.a: SCAI runs a multi-source search (Serper, APIs, RSS, ATS platforms) based on your profile. Results are scored from 0 to 100. On the free plan, 10 results are visible — the rest unlock with a paid plan.

faq.q: How many sources are actually scanned?
faq.a: The registry covers up to 2005 sources depending on your plan (Free 100, Pro 1000, Premium 2005) — job boards, RSS, ATS (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable), and LinkedIn/Upwork on demand for paid scans. The number shown on the founder dashboard distinguishes configured sources from those that actually delivered a result recently.
Genius status is granted to exceptional profiles. It offers: a gold badge on your profile, priority in search results, early access to new features.

faq.q: How do I connect Gmail for Cowork?
faq.a: In Settings → Connections, click "Connect Gmail". You'll be redirected to the Google authorization page.

Yes. Your data is hosted on Supabase (GDPR-compliant), encrypted in transit (HTTPS), and your passwords are never stored in plain text. Searcher Connector never asks for or stores the password of your LinkedIn, Upwork or other network accounts — we never create or manage an account on your behalf on those platforms.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Go to Settings → Danger Zone → Delete account. Deletion is final within 30 days. You can also send a request to biyostephane26@gmail.com.

faq.q: Can I use Searcher from my phone?
faq.a: Searcher Connector is a Progressive Web App (PWA). On mobile, you can add it to your home screen from Chrome or Safari.
Cowork is your unified inbox. It groups your Gmail emails and WhatsApp messages related to your applications. SCAI can automatically reply to simple messages with your signature.

faq.q: Does SCAI really apply on its own, everywhere?
faq.a: No, and that's intentional. SCAI always writes an application message tailored to each listing. REAL automatic submission is only possible on listings published via Greenhouse or Lever (public form, no account required) — that's the only situation where no platform's rules are broken. Everywhere else (LinkedIn, Upwork, Freelancer, company sites), the message is ready, but the final send remains your click — via the listing page directly, the "serial application" mode, or the browser extension.

faq.q: Why doesn't SCAI apply automatically on LinkedIn or Upwork?
faq.a: These platforms explicitly forbid automated submission of applications/proposals in their terms of use, with penalties up to permanent account suspension. It's not a technical limitation on our end — Greenhouse and Lever expose public forms designed to be filled by any candidate, which changes everything legally.

faq.q: What is the browser extension, and is it mandatory?
faq.a: It's an optional tool (Pro/Premium) that automatically pre-fills application forms on any site when you open the page — you never have to search/copy the message yourself. On recognized ATS (Greenhouse/Lever), you can also enable automatic sending. It only works while you're present on the page (browser security constraint) — it can't act in your absence, unlike server-side ATS submission.

faq.q: What happens if a CAPTCHA blocks an automatic submission?
faq.a: SCAI cleanly gives up and notifies you — never an attempt to bypass it. You then apply manually for that specific listing.

faq.q: Can SCAI log into my accounts (LinkedIn, Upwork...) to apply on my behalf?
faq.a: No. Searcher Connector never creates an account and never asks for your credentials on a third-party service. The only possible connections (Gmail for Cowork) go through official Google authorization (OAuth) — we never see your password.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.lastUpdated: Last updated: June 2025 — Compliant with GDPR and African data protection laws

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.content: The data controller for personal data processing is Biyo Stéphane, founder of Searcher Connector, based in Cameroon. Contact: biyostephane26@gmail.com

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: We collect: full name, email address, password (hashed), profile photo (optional), professional domain, country, city, external links (LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio), uploaded CV or documents (optional), search preferences. Automatic data: IP address, browsing logs, in-app actions, messages with SCAI, scan results.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of processing
sections.content: Your data is used to: provide and improve services, personalize scan results, send applications on your behalf (with your consent), notify you of new opportunities, process payments, prevent fraud, and comply with our legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.content: Contract performance for providing the Service, consent for marketing communications and autonomous scans, legitimate interest for security and Service improvement, legal obligation for retention of certain data.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
sections.content: Your data is never sold. It may be shared with: Supabase (DB hosting, GDPR-compliant), MongoDB Atlas (cache and sessions), Flutterwave/Monetbil (payments), Groq/Google AI (AI processing without personal storage), Vercel (hosting), Resend (transactional emails).

sections.title: 6. Data retention
sections.content: Account data: as long as the account is active + 3 years after deletion. Scan logs: 48h (MongoDB cache with automatic TTL). SCAI conversations: kept until you disable "Conversation memory" in Settings (in which case they're no longer saved) or you request their deletion. Payment data: 10 years (legal tax obligation).

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.content: Under GDPR: right of access to your data, right to rectification, right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"), right to portability, right to object to certain processing, right to restriction. To exercise these rights: biyostephane26@gmail.com. Response within 30 days.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.content: We implement: encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS), restricted access to sensitive data, secure authentication via Supabase Auth, Content Security Policy (CSP), HSTS, and regular security audits. Passwords are never stored in plain text.

sections.title: 9. Cookies
sections.content: Searcher Connector uses essential cookies (authentication, language preferences) and anonymized analytics cookies. No third-party advertising cookies are used.

sections.title: 10. International transfers
sections.content: Your data may be processed outside your country of residence. These transfers are carried out with appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses, certifications).

sections.title: 11. DPO contact
sections.content: For any question regarding the protection of your data: biyostephane26@gmail.com — Subject: "Data Protection — Searcher Connector"

sections.title: 1. Service overview
sections.content: Searcher Connector ("the Service") is a job and freelance mission search automation platform. It is operated by Biyo Stéphane, founder, based in Cameroon. The Service uses an AI agent (SCAI) to scan public web sources and suggest opportunities matching the user's profile.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance of terms
sections.content: By creating an account on Searcher Connector, you fully accept these Terms. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the Service. Using the Service implies acceptance of our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 3. Description of services
sections.content: Searcher Connector offers: automatic scanning of opportunities (jobs and freelance), AI scoring and filtering of results, personalized application preparation by SCAI, unified inbox (Gmail + WhatsApp), integrated professional social network, and an AI agent (SCAI) available 24/7. Important: SCAI prepares and writes applications, but does not automatically submit them to an employer or recruiter — the final send remains a user action (via the listing link or indicated channel), except for features explicitly described as fully automated.

sections.title: 4. User accounts
sections.content: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials. You agree to provide accurate information and keep your profile up to date. Only one account per individual is allowed. The Searcher Connector team reserves the right to suspend or delete any account in case of abusive use.

sections.title: 5. Plans and billing
sections.content: The Service offers a free plan with limited features and paid plans with unlimited access. Payments are processed via Mobile Money (Monetbil), credit card (when available), or manual bank transfer/deposit confirmed by email and manually activated by the team for areas where automatic payments aren't yet available. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. No refunds are granted for an already-started period, unless required by law.

sections.title: 6. Acceptable use
sections.content: It is strictly forbidden to use Searcher Connector to: massively scrape data, automate fraudulent applications, send spam, circumvent free plan limitations, use fictitious identity information, or any act contrary to applicable laws.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
sections.content: Searcher Connector, its source code, interfaces, logo, brand, and algorithms are the exclusive property of Biyo Stéphane. Any reproduction or use without authorization is prohibited. AI-generated content belongs to the user who generated it.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.content: Searcher Connector is a tool to assist in finding opportunities. It does not guarantee obtaining a job, mission, or funding. Searcher Connector's liability is limited to the amount paid by the user over the past 3 months.

sections.title: 9. Modifications
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Users will be notified by email 30 days before any significant modification.

sections.title: 10. Governing law
sections.content: These Terms are governed by Cameroonian law. In case of dispute, the parties agree to seek an amicable solution before any legal action.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: For any question regarding these Terms: biyostephane26@gmail.com
